summary: Iteration 21 UroPay backend integration — 29/29 pytest tests PASSED against production UroPay upstream (api.uropay.me). Covered public + admin config, legacy imbpay/cashfree removal, /payments/uropay/initiate (validation + real create-order returning URPY... id + base64 QR + upi:// string + persisted on order), /payments/uropay/submit-utr (validation + real UroPay call), /payments/uropay/verify branches (NOT_INITIATED / CREATED / idempotent-paid), and /webhooks/uropay end-to-end (missing sig 401, bad sig 401, valid sig with unknown order returns matched:false, valid COMPLETED signature flips order to paid+confirmed with UroPay tracking event, idempotent replay). Regression on pay-kit → orders/{id} confirmed. Webhook HMAC signature was computed via sha512(secret) → HMAC-SHA256 of the compactly-JSON-serialized ordered payload per uropay_utils.verify_webhook_signature spec.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 3225 lines — should be split into routers per domain (payments, orders, mlm, admin, auth) for maintainability.

/payments/uropay/verify catches upstream exception and raises 400. If UroPay is transiently down this masks a 5xx-worthy scenario; consider distinguishing network/timeout from business errors (e.g., 502 vs 400).

_finalize_paid_uropay_order uses atomic $ne:'paid' guard for idempotency — good. However the stock decrement loop runs unconditionally inside the modified_count==1 branch which is correct, but the referral business activation still relies on a subsequent read of the (pre-update) order snapshot; consider re-reading the order after update to avoid stale is_hamper checks in edge cases where items are mutated concurrently.
Webhook handler returns 200 with matched:false for unknown orders — acceptable, but consider logging these for observability (currently silent).

verify_webhook_signature reconstructs the payload dict per event type instead of hashing the raw request body. This works but is fragile — any new UroPay event key ordering change requires code updates. Prefer hashing the raw body as-received (UroPay's actual signing input) if their docs allow.
seed_data_creation: pay-kit produced a pending joining order for test1_1785761123 (order_id captured in fixture); after webhook COMPLETED test, that order is now marked paid and its business is activated.
